statement: At its Advancing AI 2026 event AMD named Anthropic as deploying up to 2 gigawatts of Instinct MI455X GPUs in Helios racks, and OpenAI as expecting to bring Helios online beginning in the fourth quarter of 2026.
why: Two named frontier labs taking AMD rack-scale systems, one with a stated start quarter, converts roadmap interest into scheduled deployments.

impact.mechanism: Named customer deployments with start dates book accelerator volume and pull through rack, power and datacenter capacity.

evidence.excerpt: bring Helios online beginning in the fourth quarter of 2026

confidence.basis: Vendor release carried by a newswire rather than fetched from the vendor's own investor site; no dollar value or delivery schedule was captured in the excerpt.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> rising); sources: AMD investor-relations press release, AMD press release via GlobeNewswire
